title: GH #83: idle-gate branch reads readConfig(controlRoot), not readConfig(root)
action: BUGFIX, red-first: write the repro test and see it fail BEFORE the fix. In packages/bee/lib/guards.mjs checkWrite() (signature :828 — options carry { sessionId = null, controlRoot: controlRootOverride = null }), the terminal-phase idle-gate branch (:1040-1041) calls readConfig(root) — the raw parameter — while controlRoot is resolved at :874 via resolveWriteTopology(root, controlRootOverride). On a companion-mounted path, root and controlRoot name DIFFERENT .bee/config.json files, so the idle gate reads a different project's config than the containment check just resolved. SCOPE (decision logged at validation): the SAME readConfig(root)-under-a-resolved-controlRoot shape exists at :460 (checkGitBashCommand — resolves its own controlRoot at :452, then reads readConfig(root) for the same idle-gate decision) and at :1012 (resolveWritePolicyMode(readConfig(root)) inside checkWrite). Fix ALL THREE call sites to read from their resolved controlRoot — same one-argument change each; leaving the bash path half-fixed re-creates issue #83 there. Test (the issue's repro branch, :1041) in packages/bee/tests/test_guards.mjs: two makeStateRepo dirs (:74); write disagreeing .bee/config.json guards.idle_gate into each (readConfig = packages/bee/lib/state.mjs:1906-1916); call checkWrite(rootA, { ...defaultState(), phase: 'compounding-complete' }, 'src/x.js', null, { controlRoot: rootB }) — sessionId MUST stay null so phase comes from the passed state and the call actually reaches the terminal branch (a sessionId routes through resolvePipeline and can short-circuit at :1012 before :1041). TERMINAL_PHASES = idle/compounding-complete (:151). Cover both directions: controlRoot config disables idle_gate -> allow; controlRoot enables (root's disables) -> deny. Do NOT add a phases-disagree leg — unreachable without sessionId plumbing (plan-check finding). No existing test passes a divergent controlRoot into checkWrite (rg confirmed zero hits) — this is the first; keep the fixture minimal. REGEN OBLIGATION (repo law), run BEFORE final verify: node scripts/render_plugin_skill_trees.mjs; node packages/bee/scripts/onboard_bee.mjs --repo-root . --apply; node scripts/release_manifest.mjs --write. Commit regenerated files in the same cell commit.

truths: For a companion-mounted path, the idle-gate decision follows controlRoot's config — the same root the containment check resolves — at all three call sites (:1041, :460, :1012 pre-fix line numbers).
For the ordinary case (root === controlRoot) behavior is unchanged.
All existing test_guards checks stay green.
artifacts: failing-then-passing test output captured in the cell trace
prohibitions: No behavior change beyond root->controlRoot for config reads under an already-resolved topology, plus the new test.

trace.outcome: Fixed idle-gate config reads (checkWrite :460/:1012/:1041) to use the resolved controlRoot instead of the raw root parameter, closing GH #83 for companion-mounted paths; added a red-first controlRoot-divergence regression test to test_guards.mjs.
